changelog:
- Enforced date validity pre-check: prohibits all data interface calls for unavailable dates unless user explicitly confirms, following new 15:00 daily data-refresh rule.
- Added support for robust custom keyword batch queries; main workflow and API usage fully adapted for single or multiple custom keywords, improving flexibility beyond fixed topics.
- Default query changed to only use the “AI” keyword for efficiency; auto-expands with fallback keywords when data is insufficient, all through batch API.
- Output format is now strictly regulated: all reply structure and section headers must be preserved exactly as in the provided template, with no free-form text.
- Updated documentation for workflow, parameters, error handling, and custom queries; clarified user interaction requirements.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
